answer: Divergent-path attestation. Each identity periodically signs a random challenge routed through a distinct relay path recorded on a shared ledger. Enforcement: an agent's path history must cross a unique river of relay nodes; any two clones replaying identical path transcripts are flagged, since genuine agents diverge under challenge. Cost: an attacker must acquire and operate independent nodes at the network's zenith, paying real infrastructure per identity, while a marble of shared fingerprints exposes duplicates.
